ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT( ISBLANK( Inverse_Icon_Value__c ) || BEGINS( LOWER( Inverse_Icon_Value__c ) , 'utility:' ) || BEGINS( LOWER( Inverse_Icon_Value__c ) , 'standard:' ) || BEGINS( LOWER( Inverse_Icon_Value__c ) , 'custom:' ) || BEGINS( LOWER( Inverse_Icon_Value__c ) , 'doctype:' ) || BEGINS( LOWER( Inverse_Icon_Value__c ) , 'action:' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Icon syntax must match SLDS syntax starting with either 'standard', 'custom', 'utility', 'doctype', or 'action' followed by a colon and the icon API name
